visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of cards that each play a video file (mp4) in place when clicked

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cells: image | body (optional title, subtitle, and a link to a video file such as .mp4, whose text becomes the play button label). A body holding only the video link puts a play button over the image

reuseGuidance: Default: 1/2/3-column grid of cover cards with a play button (cover song samples). Add the text-over-image option for wide photo tiles with title, subtitle and watch button laid over the image, 2 columns (live performances).
